name: connected to Ollama
js: return t.$('#status .status-text').textContent

name: model list filled
js: return [...t.$('#modelSelect').options].map(o => o.value)

name: empty map hint
js: return t.$('#canvas').classList.contains('empty')

name: + Note opens the inspector
js: t.$('#addNodeBtn').click(); return [t.$('#inspector').hidden, t.count(), document.activeElement.id]

name: typing a title updates the card
js: t.type('#inspTitle', 'Bloom filters'); t.type('#inspBody', 'A Bloom filter answers set membership with false positives but no false negatives.'); return t.$('.node .node-title').textContent

name: keywords computed after typing stops
js: return await t.until(() => t.$('#inspKeywords').value, 5000)

name: saved to localStorage
js: await t.sleep(400); return t.state().graph.nodes[0].title

name: use the small model
js: const s = t.$('#modelSelect'); s.value = 'qwen3.5:2b'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await t.sleep(300); return t.state().settings.model

name: chat streams a reply
js: t.$('#input').value = 'In two short sentences: what is a hash table, and how do hash collisions get resolved?'; t.$('#composer').requestSubmit(); await t.until(() => !t.$('#stopBtn').hidden, 5000); await t.until(() => t.$('#stopBtn').hidden, 180000); const m = [...document.querySelectorAll('.msg.assistant .msg-body')].pop(); return [m.textContent.length > 20, !!m.querySelector('p'), t.$('#chatTitle').textContent]
expect: In two short sentences: what is a hash table, and how do has

name: notes extracted into the map
js: await t.until(() => t.$('#extractStatus').textContent === '' && document.querySelectorAll('.node').length > 1, 180000); await t.sleep(300); return [document.querySelectorAll('.node.kind-topic').length, document.querySelectorAll('.node').length > 2, document.querySelectorAll('.msg.assistant .chip').length > 0]

name: toast
js: return t.toast()

name: Stop cancels a long reply
js: t.$('#input').value = 'Write a 600-word essay about the history of hash functions.'; t.$('#composer').requestSubmit(); await t.until(() => !t.$('#stopBtn').hidden, 5000); await t.sleep(2500); t.$('#stopBtn').click(); await t.until(() => t.$('#stopBtn').hidden, 5000); await t.sleep(400); const s = t.state(); const m = s.chat[s.chat.length - 1]; return [m.streaming, m.content.length > 0 || m.error === 'Stopped.']

name: cancel the extraction it started
js: await t.sleep(300); const b = t.$('#cancelExtract'); if (b) b.click(); await t.until(() => t.$('#extractStatus').textContent === '', 20000); return true

name: state survives a reload
js: await t.sleep(400); return document.querySelectorAll('.node').length

name: same notes after reload
js: await t.sleep(300); return [document.querySelectorAll('.node').length > 2, document.querySelectorAll('.msg').length]

name: import a text file without extraction
js: t.files('#docFile', [new File(['Consistent hashing\n\nConsistent hashing maps keys and servers onto a ring, so adding a server only moves a fraction of the keys.'], 'consistent_hashing-notes.md', {type: 'text/markdown'})]); await t.until(() => t.$('#docDialog').open, 5000); const hint = t.$('#docHint').textContent; t.$('#docExtract').checked = false; t.$('#docOk').click(); await t.until(() => t.toast().startsWith('Added document note'), 10000); return [hint.startsWith('1 section will be sent to qwen3.5:2b'), t.toast(), document.querySelectorAll('.node.kind-source').length]

name: drop a PDF and extract notes from it
js: const b = Uint8Array.from(atob(''), c => c.charCodeAt(0)); t.drop([new File([b], 'merkle.pdf', {type: 'application/pdf'})]); await t.until(() => t.$('#docDialog').open, 20000); const list = t.$('#docList').textContent; t.$('#docExtract').checked = true; t.$('#docOk').click(); await t.until(() => /merkle\.pdf: \d+ notes? added from 1 section/.test(t.toast()), 180000); const doc = t.state().graph.nodes.find(n => n.title === 'merkle'); return [/merkle\.pdf1 pages · \d+ chars/.test(list), doc.kind, doc.text.startsWith('[Page 1]\nMerkle trees')]

name: keyword links: Link now
js: t.$('#kwBtn').click(); t.$('#kwRun').click(); return t.toast()

name: filter dims non-matching notes
js: t.type('#search', 'merkle'); const dim = document.querySelectorAll('.node.dim').length, all = document.querySelectorAll('.node').length; t.type('#search', ''); return dim > 0 && dim < all

name: Tidy leaves no overlapping cards
js: t.$('#tidyBtn').click(); await t.sleep(6000); const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.node')].map(e => e.getBoundingClientRect()); let o = 0; for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < r.length; j++) { const a = r[i], b = r[j]; if (a.left < b.right && b.left < a.right && a.top < b.bottom && b.top < a.bottom) o++; } return o

name: pin a note to chat context
js: const id = t.state().graph.nodes.find(n => n.title === 'merkle').id; t.$(`.node[data-id="${id}"] .node-body`).dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', {bubbles: true, button: 0, clientX: 0, clientY: 0})); t.$('#canvas').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', {bubbles: true, button: 0, clientX: 0, clientY: 0})); await t.until(() => !t.$('#inspector').hidden, 3000); t.$('#inspPin').click(); return [t.$('#contextBar').hidden, t.$('#contextBar').textContent.includes('merkle'), t.$('#inspPin').textContent]

name: import an export (replacing the map)
js: const s = t.state(); const n = s.graph.nodes.length; s.app = 'ollama-notes'; s.version = 1; s.exportedAt = new Date().toISOString(); s.graph.nodes = s.graph.nodes.slice(0, 2); t.files('#importFile', [new File([JSON.stringify(s)], 'x.json', {type: 'application/json'})]); await t.until(() => t.toast() === 'Imported', 5000); await t.sleep(400); return [document.querySelectorAll('.node').length, 'app' in t.state()]

name: clear the map (confirm accepted)
js: t.$('#clearMapBtn').click(); await t.sleep(300); return [t.count(), t.$('#canvas').classList.contains('empty')]

name: new chat
js: t.$('#newChatBtn').click(); await t.sleep(300); return [document.querySelectorAll('.msg').length, t.$('#chatTitle').textContent]

name: settings dialog round trip
js: t.$('#settingsBtn').click(); const hostRow = t.$('#setHostRow').hidden; t.$('#setTemp').value = '5'; t.$('#settingsDialog').close(); await t.sleep(300); return [hostRow, t.state().settings.temperature]
